title: 第5章 我去修仙了那孩子是谁的第6章 爸爸你不要走
slug: 都市修仙五年下山就无敌
content_zh:
当叶东山用轮椅推着妻子赵茹，去办理出院手续时，整个平海市人民医院都轰动了。
在病床上躺了五年的植物人苏醒，这简直是奇迹！
曾负责治疗的主任医师听闻后，明明刚下夜班准备睡觉，骑着小电动车屁颠屁颠来了医院，那叫一个热泪盈眶。
医术最伟大的地方，就在于能够创造奇迹。
“是我侄子叶凡的功劳，他救的我，针灸！”
赵茹早餐吃了点稀饭，人也有了些许精神，见人就吹嘘自家侄子有本事。
“是吗？那可太厉害了，有机会一定要跟他探讨医术。”
虽然医生护士们这么说，但显然不信，叶凡也不在乎，一行人很快回到炼钢厂职工楼。
“二叔，二婶，听琳琳说你们把房子也卖了，以后就先住这里，等过段时间我去东海市买栋别墅，你们再搬过去养老。”
叶凡有这个自信。
好歹也是修仙者，虽然才修炼五年，但境界已是筑基巅峰，赚点钱不是简简单单？
唯一可惜的，就是二叔二婶还有琳琳没有灵根，并不适合修炼。
所以关于修仙的事，叶凡并没有告诉他们。
人生在世难得糊涂，有时候知道的太多，并不会过的更快乐，反倒徒增烦恼。
“好好好。”
赵茹忽然想起什么，问道：“对了，老头子，我昏迷时，是不是有个小姑娘来照顾过我，好像是叫……柳盈盈？”
“你怎么知道的。”叶东山满脸震惊。
“我当时虽然昏迷，但偶尔能听到别人说话。只记得她当时哭的很伤心，说她是叶凡的女朋友，找不到他了，还说要去东海市读书了，以后有机会再来看我。”
赵茹不由瞪了叶凡一眼：“臭小子，你真是伤透了好姑娘的心，你必须得跟人家当面道歉，解释清楚你这五年跑去了哪里，听到没有！”
“二婶，我会找到她的。”

叶凡轻叹一声。
只是不知道，柳盈盈会不会给他一个解释的机会。
……
除了下山前的一个月，在昆仑山的五年时间基本是枯燥乏味甚至痛苦的。
但下山后的每一天，叶凡都很忙碌，他用了一个月时间为二叔二婶用中药调理身子。
二叔的满头白发已经变黑了一半，身体明显健康许多，二婶也能自己站起身活动了。
期间叶凡炼制了四枚护身玉佩。
过程呕心沥血，不仅灌注了大量灵力，还用了四滴纯阳精血。
须知精血极其贵重，凝聚一滴所需时间以年计，而纯阳之体的精血堪称至宝。
好在一切是值得的，这四枚护身玉佩不仅能趋福避祸，还能抵挡筑基后期高手全力一击。
“这玉佩必须贴身佩戴，洗澡或睡觉也不能摘下来，一旦破碎要立刻联系我！”
许是叶凡表情严肃。
叶琳忍不住撒起娇来：“知道了哥，这么凶干嘛。”
叶东山跟赵茹见玉佩就是普通样式，撑死一两千块钱，麻溜痛快戴在脖子上，孩子的心意嘛。
叶凡又将第四枚护身符递给赵茹，说道：“二婶，这玉佩给我叶芸姐邮过去，记得让她务必佩戴。”
content_en:
When Ye Dongshan pushed his wife Zhao Ru in a wheelchair to go through the discharge procedures, the entire Pinghai People's Hospital was shocked.
It is a miracle that a vegetative person who has been lying in a hospital bed for five years wakes up!
After the chief physician who was responsible for the treatment heard about it, he rode a small electric car to the hospital just after getting off the night shift and was ready to go to bed. It made him burst into tears.
The greatest thing about medical skills is that they can create miracles.
"It's all thanks to my nephew Ye Fan. He saved me with acupuncture!"
Zhao Ru had some porridge for breakfast, and she felt a little energetic. She boasted about her nephew's abilities when meeting people.
"Really? That's amazing. I must discuss medical skills with him if I have the chance."
Although the doctors and nurses said this, they obviously didn't believe it, and Ye Fan didn't care. The group quickly returned to the staff building of the steelmaking plant.
"Second uncle, second aunt, I heard from Linlin that you have sold your house, and you will live here first. After a while, I will go to Donghai City to buy a villa, and you will move there for retirement."
Ye Fan has this confidence.
After all, he is also an immortal cultivator. Although he has only practiced for five years, his realm is already at the peak of foundation building. Isn't it easy to make some money?
The only pity is that the second uncle, second aunt, and Linlin have no spiritual roots and are not suitable for cultivation.
Therefore, Ye Fan did not tell them about cultivating immortals.
It is rare to be confused in life. Sometimes knowing too much will not lead to a happier life, but will only increase worries.
"Okay, okay."
Zhao Ru suddenly remembered something and asked: "By the way, old man, when I was in a coma, was there a little girl who took care of me? She seemed to be named...Liu Yingying?"
"How do you know?" Ye Dongshan was shocked.
"Although I was in a coma at the time, I could occasionally hear other people talking. I just remember that she was crying very sadly, saying that she was Mark's girlfriend and could not find him. She also said that she was going to Donghai City to study and would come see me again if she had the opportunity."
Zhao Ru couldn't help but glared at Ye Fan: "You brat, you really broke the heart of a good girl. You must apologize to me in person and explain clearly where you have been in the past five years. Do you hear me!"
"Second Aunt, I will find her."
Ye Fan sighed softly.
I just don’t know if Liu Yingying will give him a chance to explain.
…
Except for the month before going down the mountain, the five years in Kunlun Mountain were basically boring and even painful.
But every day after coming down the mountain, Ye Fan was very busy. He spent a month using Chinese medicine to recuperate the health of his second uncle and second aunt.
The second uncle's white hair has turned half black, and his body is obviously much healthier. The second aunt can also stand up and move on her own.
During this period, Ye Fan refined four protective jade pendants.
The process was painstaking, not only infusing a large amount of spiritual power, but also using four drops of pure Yang essence and blood.
It should be noted that essence and blood are extremely precious, and the time required to condense one drop is measured in years, and the essence and blood of a pure Yang body is considered a treasure.
Fortunately, everything is worth it. These four protective jade pendants can not only attract good fortune and avoid disaster, but can also withstand the full blow of masters in the late stage of foundation building.
"This jade pendant must be worn close to the body and cannot be taken off when bathing or sleeping. If it breaks, please contact me immediately!"
Xu Ye Fan had a serious expression.
Ye Lin couldn't help but act coquettishly: "I know, brother, why are you so fierce?"
Ye Dongshan and Zhao Ru saw that the jade pendant was an ordinary style, costing one or two thousand yuan, and they could wear it around their necks happily, just as the children wanted.
Ye Fan handed the fourth amulet to Zhao Ru and said, "Second Aunt, send this jade pendant to me, Sister Ye Yun, and remember to ask her to wear it."
